resource: WORLD_CLOCK deltas (state domain 18, capability 19 WORLD_LIGHT_V1) per session per 10,000 ms
allocation_impact: A change of light level or Tibian hour earlier than 10,000 ms after the last delta is held, not queued: the next due check sends only the current clock. Each WorldClockV1 payload is at most 9 bytes and the decoder refuses a longer one on length before reading any field. Non-durable; nothing is allocated past the bound.
boundary_tests: max=1 per 10,000 ms: apps/game-server/src/world_clock.rs deltas_follow_light_changes_and_hours_at_most_every_ten_seconds (a change inside the interval sends nothing; the first check after it sends one delta)
payload max=9: crates/protocol-oteryn/src/world_clock_tests.rs the_clock_round_trips_within_its_bound (the largest clock is exactly 9 bytes)
payload max+1=10: crates/protocol-oteryn/src/world_clock_tests.rs malformed_clocks_fail_closed (10 bytes are refused LimitExceeded)
notes: WORLD-INTERACTION-0 §10 and §12. Mirrors max_payload_bytes of the domain 18 snapshot and delta types. Registered by CLOCK-1 (#2053, #2114).
